source_bandwidth_foundation.claim: Bandwidth is Available Organizational Freedom, a relationship/capacity quantity; Resolution and Bandwidth are complementary and coupled by depth.

source_R35_shared_resolution.claim: Resolution is graph-valued rather than naturally one scalar; the full depth profile is a sequence of graph-valued states.

source_R23_bandwidth_graph.claim: Bandwidth is naturally a restriction of an existing transformation graph; Gen_B(x) is the available primitive transformation family.

source_TOME_1_8.claim: History is ordered traversal; opposite traversals can occupy the same geometry; first fold changes relation; shared history can make return to the pre-contact condition impossible.

source_R36_R37_torus.claim: T2=S1xS1 is a local two-phase Resolution representation; it is not the global Genesis geometry and is not automatically forced in a generic relational system.
